meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes, GSAP timelines, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 HyperFrames 合成添加安全的关键帧动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 HyperFrames 中制作精确的 2D/3D 关键帧动画
copy.tagline_en: Add seek-safe keyframe animations to HyperFrames compositions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need precise 2D/3D keyframe animations in HyperFrames

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按这套流程为你的 HyperFrames 合成编写并校验关键帧:先识别动画主体与状态,选择最小实现机制(GSAP、CSS、Anime.js 等),再生成 seek-safe 的关键帧,并用 lint、check、keyframes 等命令验证可靠性。
howto.when: 当你的 HyperFrames 合成需要 seek-safe 的关键帧、GSAP 时间线等动画机制,或要求做关键帧诊断时触发。

say.text: 把这段动画改成 seek-safe 的关键帧,用 GSAP 时间线实现。
say.note: Claude 会按 GSAP 骨架生成并注册时间线。

say.text: 检查我的关键帧,跑一下 hyperframes keyframes 诊断。
say.note: Claude 会用 CLI 验证关键帧并指出问题。

say.text: 给这个合成加上 SVG 描边生长动画。

howto.what_en: Claude will author and verify seek-safe keyframes for HyperFrames compositions: identify the subject, choose the minimal mechanism (GSAP, CSS, Anime.js), generate keyframes, and validate via lint/check/keyframes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a HyperFrames composition needs seek-safe keyframes, GSAP timelines, or similar animation mechanisms, or when keyframe diagnostics are requested.

say_en.text: Turn this animation into seek-safe keyframes using a GSAP timeline.
say_en.note: Claude will generate and register the timeline per the GSAP skeleton.

say_en.text: Check my keyframes and run the hyperframes keyframes diagnostic.
say_en.note: Claude will validate via CLI and report issues.

say_en.text: Add an SVG stroke-draw animation to this composition.
say_en.note: Claude will use DrawSVG or dasharray.
